story.iWant: to soft-delete customers (mark inactive, preserve history)
story.soThat: customer records are retained for audit purposes
story.tasks: - Task 1: Implement DELETE endpoint in CustomerController (AC: #1, #11) - Task 2: Create DeleteCustomerRequest DTO (AC: #6) - Task 3: Implement soft-delete logic (AC: #2, #3, #5) - Task 4: Implement audit entry creation with deletion reason (AC: #6) - Task 5: Handle associated policies (AC: #8, #9) - Task 6: Implement search filter for soft-deleted customers (AC: #7)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. DELETE /api/v1/customers/{customerId} endpoint implemented 2. Sets customer status to INACTIVE (soft delete) 3. Returns 200 OK or 204 No Content 4. Customer not found returns 404 Not Found 5. Deleting already-inactive customer returns 200 OK (idempotent) 6. Audit entry created with deletion reason 7. Soft-deleted customer still queryable via GET (visible to compliance roles) 8. Associated policies remain ACTIVE (customer status independent) 9. Policies cannot be linked to INACTIVE customers for new creations 10. Hard delete not possible via API (compliance requirement) 11. Requires ROLE_COMPLIANCE_OFFICER or ROLE_ADMIN authorization

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR004: Soft-delete customer (mark inactive while preserving history for compliance). Soft-delete preserves data for audit and compliance purposes.

artifact.reason: Add DELETE /{customerId} endpoint to existing controller.

story-context.constraints: - Soft delete only: Set status=INACTIVE, do NOT delete from database - Idempotent: Deleting INACTIVE customer returns 200 OK (no error) - Deletion reason optional but recommended (max 500 chars) - Add deletedAt (LocalDateTime) field to Customer entity - Add deletionReason (String) field to Customer entity - Audit entry must record deletion reason - Authorization: COMPLIANCE_OFFICER or ADMIN only - Soft-deleted customers visible to compliance roles via includeDeleted flag - Hard delete not exposed via API (data retention requirement) - Story 2.5 must be completed (CustomerService update logic exists)

CustomerService deleteCustomer method

tests.standards: Testing standards require soft-delete tests, idempotency tests, audit entry verification with deletion reason, and role-based access tests.
tests.locations: - genapp-backend/src/test/java/com/example/cicsgenapp/controller/CustomerControllerTest.java (MODIFY - add DELETE tests) - genapp-backend/src/test/java/com/example/cicsgenapp/service/CustomerServiceTest.java (MODIFY - add delete tests)
tests.ideas: AC1: Controller test - DELETE /api/v1/customers/{customerId}, verify 200 or 204 status AC2: Service test - Delete customer, verify status changed to INACTIVE AC3: Service test - Delete customer, verify 200 OK response AC4: Service test - Delete non-existent customer, verify 404 Not Found AC5: Service test - Delete already-inactive customer, verify 200 OK (idempotent) AC6: Service test - Delete with reason, verify auditService called with deletion reason AC7: Integration test - Soft-deleted customer still retrievable via GET (compliance role can see) AC8: Integration test - Verify associated policies remain ACTIVE after customer deletion AC9: Integration test - Attempt to create policy linked to INACTIVE customer, verify validation error AC10: Service test - Verify customer NOT hard-deleted from database AC11: Controller test - Delete without COMPLIANCE_OFFICER role, verify 403 Forbidden
